crossRefs.note: He said, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand…
until Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which Yahweh your God gives them…
But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you…
You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants…
Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood…
He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Yahweh had given…
For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter…
Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
“Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one…
It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will…
He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of Yahweh’s word, which Yahweh spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For Yahweh…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: “Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.
translations.bsb: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to His people Israel according to all that He promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises He made through His servant Moses.
translations.kjv: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
translations.asv: Blessed be Jehovah, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.
